We provide the APIs, banking infrastructure, and tools that businesses use to build accounts, payments, cards, savings, investments, and credit.

They are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:&nbsp;

&nbsp;Job Position: Technical Product Manager

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Hybrid

What We Are Looking For


	We&#39;re looking for a Technical Product Manager to help shape and build the products and infrastructure that power financial services on Anchor.
	This is a highly technical product role.
	You&#39;ll work closely with engineering, design, operations, compliance, and business teams to turn complex financial and technical problems into simple, scalable products.
	We&#39;re looking for someone who can go deep into APIs, systems, integrations, data, and technical architecture, while still thinking from the perspective of customers and business outcomes.
	You should be comfortable working closely with engineers, asking the right technical questions, making product trade-offs, and taking products from problem definition through to production.


What You Will Do


	Own the product lifecycle from discovery and problem definition through development, launch, and iteration.
	Work closely with engineering teams to define product requirements, technical specifications, APIs, workflows, and edge cases.
	Translate complex financial, operational, and technical problems into clear product requirements and solutions.
	Partner with engineers on system design, integrations, APIs, data flows, and technical trade-offs.
	Define product priorities and roadmaps based on customer needs, business impact, and technical constraints.
	Work across teams to deliver reliable products in a highly regulated and technically complex environment.
	Use data, customer feedback, and product insights to identify opportunities and improve existing products.
	Own product documentation, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release planning.
	Identify dependencies, risks, and edge cases early and drive them to resolution.
	Work closely with engineering and operations teams to monitor products in production and continuously improve them.
	Help build products that make complex financial infrastructure simple and easy for businesses to use.


What We Are Looking For


	&nbsp;Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor`s Degree
	4&ndash;6 years of product management experience, preferably building technical products, APIs, platforms, or infrastructure.
	Strong technical understanding of APIs, backend systems, databases, integrations, and software development workflows.
	Experience working closely with engineering teams and the ability to engage in technical discussions.
	Strong understanding of product development, system design, and technical trade-offs.
	Experience writing clear product requirements, specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break complex problems into simple solutions.
	Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, design, operations, and business teams.
	Strong ownership &mdash; you take responsibility for outcomes, not just requirements.
	Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.
	Strong product sense and an obsession with building simple, reliable experiences for customers and developers.
	Bonus: Experience in fintech, banking, payments, financial infrastructure, B2B SaaS, developer platforms, or API products.


Salary

Technical Product Manager Job at Oconsulting Limited




        
    

        
        Oconsulting Limited - Our client, Anchor is a YC-backed global banking and payments platform building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial products across emerging markets. We provide the APIs, banking infrastructure, and tools that businesses use to build accounts, payments, cards, savings, investments, and credit.

They are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Technical Product Manager

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Hybrid

What We Are Looking For
     

            
    




	We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to help shape and build the products and infrastructure that power financial services on Anchor.
	This is a highly technical product role.
	You'll work closely with engineering, design, operations, compliance, and business teams to turn complex financial and technical problems into simple, scalable products.
	We're looking for someone who can go deep into APIs, systems, integrations, data, and technical architecture, while still thinking from the perspective of customers and business outcomes.
	You should be comfortable working closely with engineers, asking the right technical questions, making product trade-offs, and taking products from problem definition through to production.


What You Will Do


	Own the product lifecycle from discovery and problem definition through development, launch, and iteration.
	Work closely with engineering teams to define product requirements, technical specifications, APIs, workflows, and edge cases.
	Translate complex financial, operational, and technical problems into clear product requirements and solutions.
	Partner with engineers on system design, integrations, APIs, data flows, and technical trade-offs.
	Define product priorities and roadmaps based on customer needs, business impact, and technical constraints.
	Work across teams to deliver reliable products in a highly regulated and technically complex environment.
	Use data, customer feedback, and product insights to identify opportunities and improve existing products.
	Own product documentation, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release planning.
	Identify dependencies, risks, and edge cases early and drive them to resolution.
	Work closely with engineering and operations teams to monitor products in production and continuously improve them.
	Help build products that make complex financial infrastructure simple and easy for businesses to use.


What We Are Looking For


	 Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor`s Degree
	4–6 years of product management experience, preferably building technical products, APIs, platforms, or infrastructure.
	Strong technical understanding of APIs, backend systems, databases, integrations, and software development workflows.
	Experience working closely with engineering teams and the ability to engage in technical discussions.
	Strong understanding of product development, system design, and technical trade-offs.
	Experience writing clear product requirements, specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break complex problems into simple solutions.
	Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, design, operations, and business teams.
	Strong ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just requirements.
	Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.
	Strong product sense and an obsession with building simple, reliable experiences for customers and developers.
	Bonus: Experience in fintech, banking, payments, financial infrastructure, B2B SaaS, developer platforms, or API products.

Engineering - Wells Advisor III Job at ABNL Limited




        
    

        
        ABNL Limited was incorporated in 1992 as an Oil and Gas servicing company with a vision to provide professional engineering and technical services to the Oil and Gas exploration and production companies in Nigeria and the West African sub-region. Since its incorporation, the company has grown in leaps and bounds, expanding its business horizon, but still within the Oil and Gas sector.
     

            
    



ABNL is a 100% owned indigenous firm, with a shareholding in excess of 100 million Naira. Its' directors are individuals of proven integrity, who over the years have acquired the requisite experience in the Oil and Gas business, as well as in the banking and finance sector. The integrity of the directors and the staff of the company have been a priceless contributive factor in the growth and wellbeing of the company.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Engineering - Wells Advisor III

Job Location: Seplat House, Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Main Function


	The Wells Advisor job role is meant to convey the generic kinds of experiences and skill proficiencies of a late-career/ Expert-competency level individual in this role. In addition to technical ability, they should demonstrate sound communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
	Resources should be well versed in drilling, well, or construction operations. Wells Advisors typically have expertise in one or more job family skills and serve as resources to mentor and develop the broader organization.
	Wells Advisors are essential in order to mentor and advise drilling and completion engineers on well planning, well design, and operational surveillance for the safe and efficient drilling and completing of drilling programs.


Tasks and Responsibilities
In addition to Level 1 and 2 tasks, a Level 3 must:


	Mentor and interface with less-experienced drilling and completion engineers.
	Provide oversight of Drilling programs, and ensure continuity and consistency in practices across multiple rig lines.
	Interface with Affiliate / Business Unit on Logistics, Environmental, Regulatory, Procurement and Cost Stewardship activities.
	Develop and lead longer-term team performance improvement initiatives and engineering studies.
	Make continuous effort to improve efficiencies in Drilling and Completion operations.
	Participate in vendor clarifications, FAT’s and package acceptance
	Review and respond to spec deviation requests • Review drawings and specifications
	Address human factors engineering as well as safety of personnel and equipment (in conjunction with Topsides and/or O&M contractor)
	Assist in development and review of commissioning and System Integration Test procedures
	Support construction and commissioning efforts as required


Requirements


	Degree in an Engineering discipline (Mechanical or Civil preferably)
	Advanced analytical and computing skills
	Experienc erequired in construction site management, preferably familiar with Drilling well site design • Adaptability to changing priorities
	Extensive experience in Drilling Rig development including FEED, Detail Design, Construction and Commissioning
	Strong interpersonal and communication skills
	Ability to organize and progress own work schedule
	Experience working within multi-disciplined team environment involving multiple stakeholders
	Familiar with applicable industry related codes (API, ASME, ANSI, SAE, ASTM, ABS, DNV, SOLAS, IMO)
	Knowledge of Offshore Oil and Gas regulations.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV in MS Word to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
